item.title: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
item.description: Arabica coffee prices hit a record level, as traders digested the withdrawal of President Trump’s threats to impose tariffs and economic sanctions on Colombia.

item.description: Gold settled 1.4% lower, down two of the past three sessions, and silver fell 2.5%, down three of the past four sessions.

item.description: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

item.title: North Korean hackers blamed for stealing record $6.3B in Binance breach

item.description: Satlyt ran a successful test this month bringing it closer to turning spacecraft, starting with satellites, into virtual data centers.

item.title: AI law firm Crosby bids on disintegrating, famed firm Weil Gotshal
item.description: Like a real-life episode of "Suits," the demise of famed white-shoe Wall Street law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges has been the talk of the legal industry. And now an AI firm has entered the picture.

item.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
item.description: Big Tech is pouring billions into AI infrastructure, but mounting debt, negative cash flow, and growing investor skepticism are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom.

item.description: Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business.

item.title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
item.description: Intel is being hurt by PC sales as the AI industry gobbles memory and other components causing PC prices to rise.

item.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
item.description: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.
